(i) the use of both temporal and spatial EEG data is more beneficial in comparison to the use of temporal EEG data only, (ii) the use of fNIRS data in addition to EEG data is more effective in comparison to the EEG only, (iii) combining both temporal and spacial information of the brain data is more effective, and (iv) the use of deep learning methods is beneficial in comparison to other methods.
combining the temporal and spatial information can improve the performance of motor imagery EEG classification.
the use of spatial information from the EEG signals can increase the performance of the classification task.

the development of novel deep learning methods for the analysis of brain signals.
the use of deep learning techniques to extract features of the brain activity in order to classify the motor imagery brain signals.
the use of spatial information of the data in addition to temporal information in order to improve the performance.
